rca of the issue: Previous duplicate /api/catalogues (4×) was caused by each form-field consumer calling loadCatalogues() independently with no in-flight sharing. Fix in /app/frontend/src/hooks/useCatalogues.js adds a module-level `inflight` promise that is reused until resolve, collapsing N concurrent callers to 1 HTTP request. Previous duplicate /api/customers/{id}/ledgers (2×) was caused by two independent useFetch consumers (Customer360.jsx line 66 and ThreeLedgers inside CustomerBits) requesting the same URL with different cache keys. Fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/v2/Customer360.jsx aligns the query-key so both consumers share one request. Both fixes verified live.
